{{Quote|Best post exchange around. You need it, we got it.|Lieutenant Prothee speaking to a customer|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Prothee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served in the [[Republic Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] fought between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR dates|4}}</ref> during the [[Battle of Ilum]], Lieutenant Prothee sold [[Armor/Legends|armor]] to Republic forces from a booth in the [[Republic base camp]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]. While stationed on Ilum, Prothee carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and wore [[Color/Legends|white]] and black armor with a helmet that left their face unprotected. Prothee had brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], dark [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and tan-colored skin.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lieutenant Prothee appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as an Armor Vendor for Republic players on Ilum.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Prothee was removed from the game along with the rest of the Armor Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
